{{Quote|Tell me, envoy Cross&mdash;what do you know about the Cleansing of Serenno?|Rodas Borgin to Jahan Cross|<ref name="AOTE2" />}}
The '''Cleansing of Serenno''' occurred shortly after the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], when [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] drove the heirs of the [[Great Houses/Legends|Great Houses]] of [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] to mass parricide. As a result, the Great Houses were brought in the bosom of the newly formed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and [[Adan Dooku]] was appointed [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count of Serenno]], liege lord of all the other [[Noble/Legends|patricians]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Most of the [[galactic community]] never knew what really happened on Serenno that day, only that the event had seen the replacement of the old heads of houses by their sons. Agent [[Jahan Cross]] of the [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] was one of the few to ever learn the true story of the Cleansing of Serenno, which he heard in [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]] from the [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]] of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Rodas Borgin]], who had drawn the first blood during the massacre.

==History==
===Prelude===
{{Quote|I bring you good news, my lord. The war has begun.''"<br />"''Excellent. Everything is going as planned.|Count Dooku and Darth Sidious|<ref name="Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]]</ref>}}
[[File:Dooku_CIS.png|thumb|left|250px|Dooku, Count of Serenno, helped start the Clone Wars.]]
In the fifth [[Standard month/Legends|month]] of the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241">{{InsiderCite|84|Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241}}</ref> a war erupted between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], a separatist union led by [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] of [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]]. That conflict, known as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], raged on for three years, destroying the lives of many and ravaging planets. In deepest secrecy, both sides of the war were manipulated by a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] named [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], better known as Palpatine, [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the Republic. Moreover, Dooku had been Sidious' [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] for about ten years, under the alias of [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Tyranus. Toward the end of the conflict in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Palpatine was ready to transform the Republic into a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|First Galactic Empire]] in his image. Dooku of Serenno, leader of the Confederacy and secret Sith apprentice, was sacrificed by his master during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]]. He was replaced by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], a fallen [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who ultimately became the black-[[Armor/Legends|armored]] Darth Vader.<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

===The cleansing===
{{Quote|Lord Vader! This is barbaric! You never spoke of this!''"<br />"''The rest of the Galaxy suffered, so now will Serenno. The houses will be cleansed by blood.|Adan Dooku and Darth Vader|<ref name="AOTE2" />}}
[[File:Before_the_cleansing.png|thumb|right|250px|Darth Vader turned the heirs of Serenno against their fathers.]]
Shortly after the end of the [[Declaration of a New Order|establishment]] of his Galactic Empire, the self-proclaimed [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine sent his new apprentice, Darth Vader, as an official representative on Serenno. The current heads of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Great Houses/Legends|Great Houses]] had been summoned along with their oldest sons, and they were asked to meet Vader in the chambers of the [[Great Assembly House/Legends|Great Assembly House]]. Once the meeting had begun, the Emperor's right-hand man accused the assembled nobles of [[Treason/Legends|treason]] for having supported the Count Dooku of Serenno, who led the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars. The nobles all protested, but their shouting was to no avail.<ref name="AOTE2" />

As a way of "cleaning" the Great Houses of Serenno, Vader announced that each heir of a given house would be anointed head of the family on the condition that they [[Death/Legends|killed]] their own [[Parent/Legends|father]]. Initially, the nobles all protested again, but the young [[Rodas Borgin]] drew the first [[Blood/Legends|blood]] by stabbing his father. Following the shock of this first murder, there was a brief moment of silence, until the heirs of the other noble houses lost all hope of getting away alive if they did not comply. Brutally, a slaughter began, with all the young nobles committing parricide in the Assembly House. When the massacre ended, the new heads of the Great Houses pledged allegiance to their liege lord, the [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count of Serenno]] [[Adan Dooku]]. He had been spared only because he had been raised away from his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] for most of his childhood.<ref name="AOTE2" />

===Aftermath===
{{Quote|That, special envoy Cross, is the truth behind the "Cleansing of Serenno."|Rodas Borgin|<ref name="AOTE2" />}}
What really happened on Serenno that [[Standard day/Legends|day]] was not revealed to the wider [[galactic community]], and most people only knew that the old heads of houses had been "dismissed" in favor of their heirs. [[Standard year/Legends|Years]] later, the [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] agent [[Jahan Cross]] was assigned to ensure that an older Rodas Borgin would be appointed as [[Regent/Legends|regent]], since the heir of [[House Dooku]], a boy named [[Bron Dooku|Bron]], was only ten years old at the [[Time/Legends|time]]. It is only when he met Borgin for the first time that Cross learned the truth about the Cleansing of Serenno.<ref name="AOTE2" />
